event.text: Cloud pick fails against the live cloud node: the runner at <private>#1533 (head b6592ca3f, installed 0181970d) sends pick `transports` as host names (handler_lane_placement_recovery.py cloud_pick, `[h.name for h in hosts]`), while omnimarket node_cloud_session_placement_effect (dev 91fa0fa9, ModelCloudSessionPlacementRequest.transports: tuple[ModelCloudTransport]) validates dicts with name, target and local, so every `run --placement cloud` ended REMOTE-LANE-NO-HOST "gave no answer ... status=failed exit=1" while `cloud-credit --slots` printed CLOUD-SLOTS free=16. The slots read cannot prove the pick path. Also ONEX_SKILL_OVERLAY_ROOTS must be the overlays subdirectory (plugins/onex-overlays/overlays), not plugins/onex-overlays, or the slots read fails with "missing field: login_fresh_s". Worked around with a one-line local patch in worktree <private><ticket>/<private> (branch omn-22245-cloud-pick-transports-dicts, uncommitted, not installed): `{"name": h.name, "target": h.target or "", "local": bool(h.local)}`; 12 lanes then started. The fix needs a PR with a test that feeds the real request model.
